name: Mahan Industries Limited
about: Mahan Industries Limited, a non-banking financial company, invests in equity shares in India. The company invests in public companies that are traded stock exchange and acquires investment in the secondary market, as well as trades in commodities. It also provides equity capital to the companies, as well as loans and debts to companies, business entities, and high net worth individuals. Mahan Industries Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
